annotations.title: Counterparty check before paying: seller terms, payout wallet, payee record, sanctions, domain

description: Check a counterparty before an agent pays it, in one call: give the paid endpoint's url, the payout address, the domain, or several. Runs the checks that fit: the seller's 402 terms, a changed payout wallet, its verified payee record, OFAC sanctions, wallet risk and domain age. Returns each result and block, review or pass taken from them. Screening aid, not legal advice. Use when an agent is about to pay a seller or wallet for the first time. Example: url=https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/btc-fees. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: The 0x payout address you are about to pay, e.g. 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045; adds the wallet check and a sanctions screen

chain.description: Network of the address: base (default), eth, arb, op or polygon

domain.description: The payee's domain when you have no paid endpoint URL, e.g. example.com

url.description: The paid endpoint you are about to pay, an absolute public https URL (give url, address, domain, or several)
